text:
Type: white wall shelf with curved brackets
Use: displaying books, frames and small decor; living room, dining room, bedroom, home office
Style: traditional, farmhouse, Scandinavian
Materials: white painted board, white painted wooden brackets with a curved profile
Colors: white, soft off-white brackets
Shape: long slim rectangular shelf resting on two scrolled corbel-like brackets with a curved underside, clean edges, light and wall-hugging
Feel: fresh, homely, calm, gentle
Goes with: pale wood, light walls, pastel or neutral textiles, ceramics; farmhouse, cottage or Scandinavian rooms
